title: Structured Street Outreach Protocol
implementation_guidance: Implement a structured street outreach protocol that includes: 1) Regular outreach schedules at consistent times and locations to build trust; 2) Carrying essential supplies including hygiene kits, socks, water, and basic first aid materials; 3) Using trauma-informed engagement approaches that respect autonomy and privacy; 4) Conducting brief health assessments focused on immediate needs and risks; 5) Providing warm handoffs to medical providers through accompaniment when possible; and 6) Maintaining detailed outreach logs documenting encounters, needs identified, and follow-up plans. The protocol should emphasize meeting people where they are physically and emotionally, with no expectation of immediate behavior change.
expected_outcomes: Increased engagement with healthcare services, improved identification of acute medical needs, enhanced trust between unsheltered individuals and healthcare providers, and more effective linkage to housing and social services.
target_population: Individuals experiencing unsheltered homelessness, particularly those with untreated medical conditions or limited healthcare access
citation: Kertesz SG, et al. Street medicine: practical recommendations for medical and psychiatric care in the context of unsheltered homelessness. J Gen Intern Med. 2022;37(7):1785-1793. doi:10.1007/s11606-022-07444-1
